3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: After receiving the news of his son's arrest, Uncle Hugo was on his way to talk to me.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: If he were to openly go against me, I'd have a big problem with my entire house. I thought about each scenario in my head and tried to devise a plan.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: Thoughts were running through my mind as I paced back and forth in my chambers.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Suddenly, there was a knock on the door.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I granted Hugo permission to enter, and he walked in. He seemed more sad than angry -- something that took me off guard.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: He bowed in front of me, lower and longer than he'd normally go for.

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "You can rise, uncle. There is no need for that."

18.speaker: Hugo Toras
18.text: "Romus, my king. May I speak freely?"

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "You always have, Hugo. Speak your mind."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "I know why you're here. Just be careful about your choice of words."

24.speaker: Hugo Toras
24.text: "Of course you do. It's about my son..."

25.speaker: Hugo Toras
25.text: "About your decision to remove him as the Duke of Iza."

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Hugo leaned forward slightly, his hands clasped together, choosing his words carefully.

27.speaker: Hugo Toras
27.text: "I understand that he was not popular in the city. King Valero himself had reservations about his readiness to become Duke. Yet..."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "It was a decision not made lightly, Uncle. The entire population was demanding his removal."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "His actions left me no choice, Uncle. He was endangering the stability of our kingdom."

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: Hugo's expression remained unchanged, but there was a flicker of sadness in his eyes.

32.speaker: Hugo Toras
32.text: "I understand the weight of the crown and the decisions it demands. But he is my son, Romus."

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: His demeanor made me feel uncomfortable. I couldn't meet his gaze. I had to look away.

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "I value your counsel, Hugo, more than you know. But some decisions must be made swiftly, to protect the realm."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "I understand what it looks like, Hugo. But Rico failed at his job. I wouldn't do anything to hurt House Toras."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "You were not consulted precisely because of this. He is your son and emotions would have risen just like they're doing right now."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "What's done is done. You should learn to accept it."

40.speaker: Hugo Toras
40.text: "You are right... I wouldn't question your judgment."

41.speaker: Hugo Toras
41.text: "I accepted it already. I wouldn't question your judgment."

42.speaker: Hugo Toras
42.text: "I have served this family and this kingdom all my life, Romus. My loyalty has never wavered."

43.speaker: Hugo Toras
43.text: "Indeed, and I wouldn't question your judgment."

44.speaker: Hugo Toras
44.text: "I know... And I wouldn't question your judgment."

45.speaker: Hugo Toras
45.text: "But as a father yourself, you must understand."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I do not doubt your loyalty, nor do I take your sacrifices for granted. Your son's removal was not a punishment but a necessity. For him, for you, for all of us."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Your loyalty and service to our family and kingdom have never been in question. I am open to discussing how we might address this situation."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "I understand your pain, uncle. But you must let it go."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Trust me. Him being the Duke of Iza was more dangerous to his life and our family's reputation."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Come now, uncle. Rico lost a job which he was unsuited for anyway. He'll survive this."

51.speaker: Hugo Toras
51.text: "I appreciate your willingness to consider a path to redemption for my son."

52.speaker: Hugo Toras
52.text: "I do not question your motives, Romus. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

53.speaker: Hugo Toras
53.text: "However, the loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

54.speaker: Hugo Toras
54.text: "Indeed, I will. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

55.speaker: Hugo Toras
55.text: "Yes. But I nonetheless believe I was owed a consultation."

56.speaker: Hugo Toras
56.text: "And the loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

57.speaker: Hugo Toras
57.text: "Some form of compensation could ease this transition."

58.speaker: Hugo Toras
58.text: "The loss of his position has... repercussions. For his future and for the name of our family."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "Your feelings are justified, Hugo. In the haste of the moment, I overlooked the personal ramifications. For that, I offer my regret. But that's all I can offer."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "What amends do you seek? Tell me."

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "I see. You seek a salve for the wound this has caused our lineage."

62.speaker: Player_Romus
62.text: "No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything. Rico must face the consequences for his actions."

63.speaker: Hugo Toras
63.text: "Not as a challenge to your authority, but as a balm for our family."

64.speaker: Hugo Toras
64.text: "I'm just asking for something in return. A role, an estate, something to maintain the dignity of my son and provide a path forward for him."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Hugo took a deep breath, his posture relaxing ever so slightly, yet there was an underlying current of disappointment in his voice.

66.speaker: Hugo Toras
66.text: "Then I shall stand by your decision, as I have always stood by you and your father before you."

67.speaker: Hugo Toras
67.text: "My loyalty to the crown and to you remains unshaken. You are my monarch, and my family."

68.speaker: Hugo Toras
68.text: "I understand you cannot offer him a title right after revoking it. But please consider offering him a job in the capital."

69.speaker: Hugo Toras
69.text: "How about he works for Duchess Azaro? As Chief of the Porte Drazon Police Department?"

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Absolutely not. I am definitely not going to trust Rico with the security of our capital."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "So he can escalate tensions right at my doorstep as well? No. I'm sorry."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "Sure. I can do that. I'll tell Lucita."

79.speaker: Hugo Toras
79.text: "What about assigning him to serve under General Azaro? As Chief of the Porte Drazon Police Department?"

80.speaker: Hugo Toras
80.text: "What about assigning him to serve under Captain Gordion? As Chief of the Porte Drazon Police Department?"

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Sure. I can do that. I'll tell Titus."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Sure. I can do that. I'll tell General Taddeus."

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: He extended his hand to me.

87.speaker: Hugo Toras
87.text: "For the kingdom, and for our family."

89.speaker: Hugo Toras
89.text: "Thank you, Romus. I am heartened by your understanding."

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: Hugo's expression softened slightly, a sign of relief mixed with the residual weight of the situation.

91.speaker: Hugo Toras
91.text: "My son’s actions notwithstanding, I believe in his capacity for growth and redemption. I am committed to guiding him on this path, for the sake of our family and Rizia."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: He extended his hand to me.

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "I value your fidelity, Hugo. I'm glad we have this mutual understanding."

94.speaker: Hugo Toras
94.text: "Very well. I shall return to my duties now."

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: As Hugo exited, I was left to ponder the intricate balance of ruling, where the lines between kinship and kingship blurred.

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: I stood up and prepared for my next meeting.

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: Hugo leaned forward slightly, his hands clasped together. His voice trembled with emotion when he spoke.

98.speaker: Hugo Toras
98.text: "Romus, how could this have happened? My son, Rico, involved in the Zille bombing? Treason against his own country?"

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: Realizing he was losing the volume of his voice, he stopped himself.

101.speaker: Player_Romus
101.text: "It's okay, Hugo. I understand that it's painful."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "I know you are angry. But it had to be done."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I also didn't want to believe it. But it's true. I'm sorry."

105.speaker: Hugo Toras
105.text: "Romus, I come before you in the deepest humility."

106.speaker: Hugo Toras
106.text: "Right now, my anger is limited to Rico."

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Hugo shook his head, his grief etched deep into the lines of his face. I hadn't seen him this sad since my father's funeral.

108.speaker: Hugo Toras
108.text: "The actions of my son... I cannot fathom what led Rico to such darkness. The bombing, the scandal over Zille's return... It's a stain upon our House."

109.speaker: Hugo Toras
109.text: "I stand here, not only as your Grand Vizier but as a father disgraced, to beg your forgiveness for the turmoil he has wrought."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "Rico's actions were indeed treachery against Rizia. But the guilt is his to bear, not yours."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "It's a tragedy that one of our own was involved. The repercussions have been severe, and we all must bear a responsibility for letting this take place."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "You need not ask for forgiveness, Uncle. Rico is already paying for his own actions."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "May the Divine forgive you and your son."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Then I accept your apologies and grant you a pardon. You are forgiven."

118.speaker: Hugo Toras
118.text: "As his father, the onus falls upon me. I failed in guiding him, in instilling the values of our lineage."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "I respect that you're taking the responsibility upon yourself, Uncle. But what's done is already done, and you are not to blame."

120.speaker: Hugo Toras
120.text: "For that, I must ask for your pardon, for my oversight, for any taint his actions have brought upon your reign."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Your integrity and loyalty have never been in question, Hugo. The heart of a father cannot always steer the will of a son."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "You cannot blame yourself for this. You couldn't have done anything about it. We must now look to the future."

125.speaker: Hugo Toras
125.text: "But... He is still my son, Romus."

126.speaker: Hugo Toras
126.text: "I understand the need for justice but is there no room for mercy for him? For a chance at redemption?"

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "He didn't have any mercy when he orchestrated the bombing that not only took lives but also our land. I'm sorry."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "Your feelings are justified, Hugo. But you are being emotional. Rico is now an enemy of the state. I offer my regret. But that's all I can offer."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "No, Uncle. I cannot offer anything. Rico must face the consequences for his actions."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "I feel your pain, Uncle. But I don't know what I can do about it now. I promise I'll try my best to mend our wounds."

132.speaker: Hugo Toras
132.text: "I do not ask for exoneration, only that his life be spared."

133.speaker: Hugo Toras
133.text: "Let him live, even if in exile or imprisonment and don't send him to Wehlen. God knows what they'll do to him there."

134.speaker: Hugo Toras
134.text: "Just let him have a chance to atone, in whatever way remains to him."

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: He lowered his head, hands still clasped. The plea was evident in his voice and posture.

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Of course. I will not do anything that will hurt his dignity further."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "I cannot promise that, Uncle. Wehlen demands justice. There is nothing I can do."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "If President Smolak demands him to be sent in exchange for Zille, I'll have to take it."

141.speaker: Hugo Toras
141.text: "But should such a black mark be placed on my family, I am not sure I will be able to serve you in the same capacity."

145.speaker: Hugo Toras
145.text: "I appreciate your willingness to consider a path to redemption for my son. I am humbled before you."

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: He extended his hand to me.

151.speaker: Hugo Toras
151.text: "I'll see you later. I shall return to my duties now."

152.speaker: Hugo Toras
152.text: "Thank you, Romus. For hearing my plea."

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: After receiving the news that I had deposed his son, Uncle Hugo was on his way to talk to me.

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "He was only a temporary steward anyway. The people of Iza were demanding the return of their Duchess."

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I looked at the oversized key on my desk. A symbolic Key to Iza.

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: The Sazons had sent it as a token of gratitude for reinstating their Duchess.

173.speaker: Hugo Toras
173.text: "Your father -- my brother -- told me that Ricardus became Duke of Iza before he was ready. I see now that he was right."

177.speaker: Player_Romus
177.text: "Wait. My father said Rico was not yet ready to rule... is this something you two often argued over?"

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: His eyes once again turned sorrowful.

179.speaker: Hugo Toras
179.text: "We quarreled about it on the very night King Valero passed, Your Majesty..."

180.speaker: Hugo Toras
180.text: "Had I known it would be our last conversation -- and had I known what Ricardus was capable of -- I would never have raised my voice to my brother."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "Wait. My father had doubts about Rico's readiness to rule... is this something you two often argued over?"

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: His eyes once again turned sorrowful.

186.speaker: Hugo Toras
186.text: "We quarreled about it on the very night King Valero passed, Your Majesty..."

187.speaker: Hugo Toras
187.text: "Had I known it would be our last conversation, I would never have raised my voice to my brother."

188.speaker: Hugo Toras
188.text: "Now he's gone... I can't lose my son, too."

189.speaker: Hugo Toras
189.text: "Now he's gone... I can't lose my son, too."
